beats: A free cloud database the app depended on simply stopped working — with no backup saved anywhere.
One pause-and-restart bought enough time to copy everything out before it died for good.
So the database moved off rented hosting onto our own server — like leaving a landlord's apartment.
Postgres now runs there directly, using the same keys, so nothing in the app changed.
It adds about 120 megabytes to the server, and the only thing that changed was the address.
